outputs.explanation: The lower graph in panel A is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of HMGB1 signal intensity (Nuc/Cyto) across genotypes, but no individual data points (dots) are overlaid on the bars, despite representing multiple cells/animals (N=4, n>100).

The lower graph in panel B is a bar chart of % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells (mean ± SD) across genotypes, but no individual data points are shown, despite N=4 mice and n>400 cells being quantified.
Panel C is a western blot with no accompanying quantification plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel D is a line plot (time on rotarod across weeks), which is exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
Panel E consists of line plots (rotarod performance across days at three time points), exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve, a line plot type exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel G consists of micrograph images with no plotted summary statistics, so the check does not apply.
Panel H contains two bar charts (molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number, mean ± SD across N=3 groups, n=9 mice each) without individual data points overlaid on the bars.
